summary: This bill amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to require that certain class II and III home-use medical devices with digital user interfaces meet nonvisual accessibility standards allowing blind or low-vision users equivalent privacy, independence, and ease of use, enforced by deeming noncompliant devices adulterated after a 2-year rulemaking process with limited waivers.
